t: This is Mornington Crescent, a terraced street in Camden Town. It was built in the 1820s on a greenfield site just north of central London. Many of the houses were split into flats in the Victorian era, and the old communal garden is now the Carreras Building. The tube station, opened in 1907, takes its name from the street. The street itself is named for Garret Wesley, the first Earl of Mornington, an Anglo-Irish politician and composer, and father of a distinguished military commander.
